pool.text: Citizens violently rebelled against the bishop and Strasbourg became a free imperial city.
The university of Strasbourg was established.
The annual Christmas market Christkindelsmärik dates back to this year.
The world's first newspaper was printed by Johann Carolus in Strasbourg.
The city became French after the conquest of Alsace by Louis XIV.
The Palais Rohan was completed and now houses three museums.
The city was liberated by the 2nd French Armoured Division under General Leclerc.
Strasbourg became the seat of early European institutions.
The European Parliament established its seat in Strasbourg.
Strasbourg established city twinning relations with Boston and Leicester.
Strasbourg established a twinning agreement with Stuttgart, Germany.
UNESCO classified the historic city centre Grande Île as a World Heritage Site.
Strasbourg established city twinning with Dresden, Germany.
Strasbourg established a cooperative decentralized agreement with Fez, Morocco.
The Jardin des deux Rives opened on both sides of the Rhine.
France and Germany created a Eurodistrict straddling the Rhine river.
Strasbourg established a cooperative decentralized agreement with Douala, Cameroon.
The Grande bibliothèque Médiathèque André Malraux was inaugurated in Strasbourg.
Three university institutions merged to form the Université de Strasbourg.
Strasbourg established a cooperative agreement with Vologda, Russia.
